jobs.title: Home Chef
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Home Chef for a household in Wuye and Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role with accommodation and weekly days off.
Responsibilities: Plan and cook daily meals for the household to a consistently high standard. Prepare dishes to suit the household's tastes and any dietary needs. Plan weekly menus and portions, and suggest new dishes. Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards. Monitor kitchen stock, buy or request groceries and keep waste low.
Requirements: Certificate from a culinary school At least 2 years' experience as a chef Good communication skills Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision Able to work in Wuye and Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Accommodation. Weekly days off.

jobs.title: Sports Sales Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Sports Sales Manager in Wuye, Abuja. This is a full-time role, and the salary of ₦250,000 per month is negotiable.
Responsibilities: Plan, source and manage the range of sports products sold online. Create and update product listings with clear descriptions, photos and prices. Track stock, sales and customer feedback, and recommend what to stock next. Work with suppliers, the sales team and customer service to keep the store running smoothly.
Requirements: Experience in e-commerce, product management, and sales A love for sports or sporting activities, with good knowledge of sports products Good communication, organisation and analytical skills Must be able to use Microsoft Word and Excel Able to commute to Wuye, Abuja CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Other statutory benefits.
